* Story
With your parents away for the summer vacation, you spend the time together with your sister-in-law.

* Synopsis
You play as a student / cameraman and enjoy various sexual activities with your sister-in-law.

* Features
- Your actions all take time. Decide what you'll do from morning to night.
- Decide your actions depending on your sister-in-law's eating, cleaning, bathing habits.
- Get H scenes through conversation, watching, peeking etc.
- Unlock a wide variety of different H scenes as you advance.
- H scenes can be unlocked with time, so you can enjoy the game even if you are poor at simulation games. (Skilled players can unlock them faster)

*H Scenes

*Other

* System specs

Notebook/laptop and onboard graphics may not be powerful enough.
32bit Windows compatibility unconfirmed.
Please play the trail version to confirm compatibility before purchase.

Recommend purchase with DLsite account for access to updates.
